title: Phone Status leads with what live sessions are driving; orphaned in-progress work sits in a separate Backlog

requirements.text: The phone Tasks view's main area lists only tasks a live session holds (plus recently done), grouped by goal
requirements.check: node mobile/bridge/test/status.test.mjs covers held vs unheld in-progress

requirements.text: In-progress tasks no live session holds appear in a separate Backlog area marked as having no session, with open ranked tasks after them
requirements.check: node mobile/bridge/test/status.test.mjs asserts orphaned tasks land in backlog with orphan flag

requirements.text: The phone renders the Backlog area separately from the driving area, collapsed by default
requirements.check: eye: TJ sees the split on the Pixel

requirements.text: The genlock suite and the bridge tests all pass after the change
requirements.check: node tests/run.mjs and node --test mobile/bridge/test pass

evidence: status.test.mjs: test 1 goals -> ['Billing','Shipped'] with only owner-held Refunds + Done1-5; new test: in-progress moved 1 min ago with no live session -> goals [] ; 13/13 pass. Live: agent-genlock driving 1 (this ticket)

status.test.mjs asserts backlog [[Stray,true,null],[Stale,true,Billing],[Invoices,false,Billing],[Waiting,false,Idle goal]]; live run: agent-genlock 17 orphans + 4 open, nightmaremode 4 orphans + 5 open (+11 more)
node tests/run.mjs 563 passed 0 failed; node --test mobile/bridge/test/*.mjs pass 13 fail 0

text: Built and tested; bridge restarted (launchctl kickstart). Pixel unreachable by adb (No route to host though nc to its port succeeds), so build 0.1.451542 shipped to the R2 link. Waiting on TJ to install from the link and eye the Backlog split (req 3).

evidence: Superseded by TJ's rule (by phone): 'the status update needs to be status update of all the active sessions only. They shouldn't dig into the backlog or open tickets or in-progress tickets; it has to be only the things the current agents are working on.' The Backlog area is removed from phone Status in T-new session-only-status.

answers.observed: status.test.mjs 13/13; live run agent-genlock 1 driving, 17 orphans
answers.absence: orphans counted from snapshot in_progress tickets with no live owner; an owner id mismatch would overcount
answers.assumption: a session holds what its agent owns or was spawned on
answers.falsify: a task a live session is on showing as not driven
